dialogues.speaker: Yukom
dialogues.text: *sigh* I didn't expect this round of guard duty to last that long. Well, Titu's finally back, at least...

response.speaker: Yukom
response.text: Haha, me? You're a curious guest. Call me Yukom. As you can see, I'm a guard at this sentry post — one of them, anyway.

response.speaker: Yukom
response.text: #But word to the wise, {M#brother}{F#sister} — you probably shouldn't just walk up to and talk to someone in the wilds here like that...

response.speaker: Yukom
response.text: This is the outer edge of the Children of Echoes' lands. Once you leave this area, you'll enter territory where any warrior's fair game to spar.

choices.text: What are you doing here, exactly?

response.speaker: Yukom
response.text: Oh, you know, guarding, standing... waiting.

response.speaker: Yukom
response.text: Alright, so I'm a little bored, and a bit tired, too. This is the Children of Echoes' sentry post, which people take turns to stand guard over every day.

response.speaker: Yukom
response.text: This is my "duty" within the tribe.

choices.text: Titu's back. Not gonna take a break?

response.speaker: Yukom
response.text: What does it look like I'm doing, eh? And now that he is, I no longer need to stare at those ominous winds, strange mutterings, and twisting shadows.

response.speaker: Yukom
response.text: #Just need to watch others work — that's the best kinda rest, {M#brother}{F#sister}!
